and WHEREAS,Transferee is the owner of certainland adjacent toTransferor's Premises ("Transferee's Land") and the buildings and improvements located thereon in the City of New York ("Transferee's Buildings"), known as 119-i21 West 28th Street, New York, New York, known as Lot 24, Block 804 on the Tax Map, and as more particularly described in Schedule "B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land together with Transferee's buildings being herein called"Transferee's Premises"); and WHEREAS, Transferee proposes to construct a new building and improvements on thereto and replacements thereof being herein collectively called"Transferee's New Building"); and WHEREAS, Transferee's New Building will contain more floor area ("Floor Area"), as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution (the "Zoning Resolution") of the City of New York, effective as of December 15, 1961,as amended from time to time, than is now available for use in respect of Transferee's Premises under the"floor area ratio" limitation contained in the present Zoning Resolution,with the result that Transferee desires to utilize the procedure available under the Zoning Resolution for combining Transferee's Premises and, possibly other adjacent parcels, and Transferor's Premises, into a single "zoning lot" for the purpose of achieving compliance by Transferee's New Building with such limitation (which procedure will make available to Transferee for such purpose the Excess Development Rightsattributable to the Transferor's Premises),("Excess Development Rights" shall mean the excess of all of the Floor Area Development Rights that are appurtenant to Transferor's Land on the date hereof, over the Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant to Transferor's Land on the date hereof that are utilized by Transferor's Building on the date hereof;
